sections.skill: Specify a similarity sequence: a dilation and rigid motions

branch.new_demand: Add a dilation: specify a similarity sequence that carries a figure onto a similar, larger or smaller figure.
branch.builds_on: FORWARD 1 minimizes rigid sequences; FORWARD 2 extends sequences to similar (not congruent) figures by adding a dilation.
